b0e1e001-0001-4000-8000-000000000009.body: Hover over a point to see its name, then click it, and the last cell names the point you clicked.

b0e1e001-0001-4000-8000-000000000010.body: Create the scatter the way you normally would, and end the cell with nothing so Pluto doesn't show the figure twice. Pass the scatter to interactables with one payloads entry per point, and the tooltip shows each point's name next to its x and y.

b0e1e001-0001-4000-8000-000000000011.body: @bind sel saves a click in sel, while hovering only shows the tooltip and leaves sel as it was. sel has one field per plot you can click, named after the plot, so the scatter's is sel.scatter.

b0e1e001-0001-4000-8000-000000000012.body: sel.scatter starts as nothing, and this cell responds when you click a point. After a click, sel.scatter.name is the point's name and sel.scatter.index is its position in your data.
